title: Eswap CoW Protocol appData — leveraged fill commitment
description: Validated schema for the CoW Protocol `fullAppData` document that authorises a leveraged Eswap fill. The document MUST be byte-for-byte the canonical serialisation produced by `EswapCoWSettlement.appDataJson(uint8)`: {"version":1,"appCode":"eswap","metadata":{"eswapLeverage":"<leverage>"}}. The order's `appData` field MUST equal `keccak256(bytes(fullAppData))` = `EswapCoWSettlement.leverageCommitment(leverage)`; otherwise the fill reverts LeverageCommitmentMismatch. Because CoW defines `appData = keccak256(fullAppData)`, this commitment is a REAL registrable appData (PUT /app_data/{hash}) — the trader registers this exact document, then signs an order whose appData is its hash.

version.description: CoW appData schema version. The canonical document pins this to the integer 1.

appCode.description: MUST equal the canonical document's appCode ('eswap'). The document is hashed verbatim, so a different appCode (or extra field, or different field order) produces a different commitment the settlement will not recognise.

eswapLeverage.description: The trader-authorised leverage, as a DECIMAL STRING (base-10, no leading zeros). MUST equal `EswapCoWSettlement._decimalString(params.leverage)`. This is the only field the settlement reads out of appData (via the commitment hash). Max 255 (uint8); the protocol enforces the real maximum leverage separately.

examples.doc: fullAppData for leverage 2 — licence the minimal canonical document exactly as written

constraints: fullAppData MUST be serialised byte-for-byte as the canonical document; any whitespace, field order or value change alters keccak256(fullAppData) and the order becomes unfillable.
order.appData MUST equal leverageCommitment(leverage) EXACTLY, or the fill reverts LeverageCommitmentMismatch (EswapCoWSettlement.sol:83).
The trader MUST register the document via PUT /app_data/{appData} before posting the order; the orderbook rejects orders whose appData has no registered document.
Do not describe solver capital as guaranteed; it is a senior priority claim with badDebt as the shortfall path.
Do not imply an active automated keeper until EswapLiquidationKeeper is deployed and its watch list is populated.
